The '''2014–15 Czech First League''', known as the '''[[Synot liga]]''' for sponsorship reasons, was the 22nd season of the [[Czech Republic]]'s top-tier [[Association football|football]] league and the first since it was renamed from the Gambrinus liga to the Synot liga due to a change in sponsor.<ref>{{cite web|last1=Adamowski|first1=Jaroslaw|title=Czech league swaps beer brand Gambrinus for betting brand Synot as title sponsor|url=http://www.insideworldfootball.com/world-football/europe/14775-czech-league-swaps-beer-brand-gambrinus-for-betting-brand-synot-as-title-sponsor|website=Inside World Football|access-date=4 June 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140613173307/http://www.insideworldfootball.com/world-football/europe/14775-czech-league-swaps-beer-brand-gambrinus-for-betting-brand-synot-as-title-sponsor|archive-date=13 June 2014|url-status=dead}}</ref> The season started on 25 July 2014 and ran until the end of May 2015, with a winter break between November and February.<ref>{{cite web|title=Termíny 2014/15: Gambrinus liga, Fotbalová národní liga a dorostenecká liga|url=http://nv.fotbal.cz/scripts/detail.php?id=150405&tmplid=1484|work=Football Association of the Czech Republic|access-date=18 May 2014|archive-date=5 March 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160305013509/http://nv.fotbal.cz/scripts/detail.php?id=150405&tmplid=1484|url-status=dead}}</ref> Fixtures for the season were announced on 25 June 2014.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://fotbal.idnes.cz/los-fotbalove-gambrinus-ligy-2014-2015-dr5-/fotbal.aspx?c=A140624_161728_fotbal_pes|title=Sparta začne obhajobu na Bohemians, Plzeň jede na úvod do Příbrami|publisher=Mladá fronta DNES|date=25 June 2014|access-date=25 June 2014}}</ref> The winners were [[FC Viktoria Plzeň]], while the previous season's champions [[AC Sparta Prague|Sparta Prague]] finished in second place.
